content: Acaz, Judá-yar-sesad

Acaz birga-dulagwen-nikadgi (20) yar-sealid. Degi, Jerusalénʼgi birgambe-gakanergwa (16) yar-sesad. Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-nuegan gwen imaksasulid. Igi e-dad-David ibmar-nuegan-imaksagusa, deyobi ibmar-imaksasulid.
Aka Rey-Acaz, Israel-reymar-igar-isganaba-nanasadba nanasad. Deginbali, Baal-nug-odummogega diregedgi-bab-dummadyob-imakleged Baal-e-wilubgan sobsabalid.

Amba deyobi, Rey-Acaz, Ben-Hinom-nebagi ina-wawadikid ogumaksabalid. Agi, e-masmala ogumakar e-bab-dummadga uksabalid. Acaz, dule-yar-baidginmalad-isguedba nanadiid-ular, Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar-wagab we-dulemar-bamalad-balimete gusad.
Deginbali, Acaz, bab-dummad-baidse ibmar-ogumakar, degine, ina-wawadikid-ogumakar aila-matusulidgi uksad. Deginbali, yar-mullugan-birgi, degi, sapi-bulamakwichid-urba uksabalid.

A-ulale, e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, Siria-e-reyga Acaz-urmaksad. Degi, Siria-dulemar egi nakwissunnad. Degine, Siria-sordamar, Damasco-neggweburse Acaz-dulemar-bukidar-gasa sesmarbalid. Degi, Rey-Acaz, Israel-reyga amba urmaklesbalid. Agi, Israel-dulemarse dummad-galakusad.
Ibagwen-dummadgi Remalías-machi-Peka, Judá-sorda-gandikmalad mili-dulanergwa-mergue (120,000) ogilosad. Ar ade, Judá-dulemar e-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-obachamaladba, deyob girgusmalad.
Sorda-wargwen-Efraín-yargined Zicriʼye-nugad, Rey-Acaz-machi-Maasías oburgwisad. Degi, Zicri reyneg-daked-dummad-Azricam oburgwisbalid, degine, rey-sorba-negdaked-Elcana oburgwisbalid.

A-ukinbali, Israel-sordamar, Judá-dulemar-mili-dulataled-ilabo (200,000) gasmarbalid: Omegan, masmala, degi, bunamalase-bakar, gasmalad. Deginbali, amar-ibe ibmar-bukidar Samaria-neggweburse sesmarbalid.

Deunni, Samariaʼgi Bab-Jehová-gayaburba-barsoged-mai daklealid. A-dulede Obedʼye-nugad. Israel-sorda-bila-onomalad Samariaʼgi ubodanimargu, Obed Israel-sordamar-abin noargusad, degi, amarga sogded: —Be-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, Judá-dulemargi bela-bela sae-itosad. A-ulale, bemarga urmaksad. Degi-inigwele, bemardi nue sae-itogedbali dule-oburgwisoggua, bela nibnegse-bakale, be-sae-itogedi warmaksad.
Emide, be sogsamalad, Judá-dulemar, degi, Jerusalén-dulemar, machergan, degi, omegan, be-maiga be imakmaloye. Ar bemarde, ¿be-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼgi nossuli na be itomarmosi? Be nosmarmogad.
Emisgi, nue an-itomalo. We-sordamar-galesad be onomala. Ar ade, ¿wemar be-gwenadgansursi? Be-gwenadganad. Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová sabsur-bemar-odurdaksokarsunnad.
Degidgine, Efraín-sorda-dummagan gwenna-gwenna, sordamar-bila-onoged-danimalad-abin-noarmalad.

Degi, we-dummagan e-sordamarga sogdemalad: —Dule-galesbukwad mer wese sedamalo. Ar degiile, Bab-Jehová-asabin anmar isgusayobi guoed. Ar ¿bemar, bur bule anmar-isguega imakbie? ¿Bur bule anmargi-ataklegega imakbimala? Adi, sulirgebed. Ar ade, anmar-isgued dogdar-obingusad, Bab-Jehová bela-bela Israelʼgi uludoed.
Degisoggu, sorda-bila-onomalad, dule-galesmalad indaksamalad. Degi, amar-ibe-ibmarmar-susmarbalidi, dummagan-wagab, degi, bela dule-bukwad-wagab gannar ega uksamarbalid.

Dule-gwenna-gwenna, dule-galebukwad-dakega nugsalesmalad. A-dummagan galesmalad-ibe-mor-susmaladi, degi, e-nag-uka-susmaladi ega gannar uksamalad. Adi, dule-galebukmalad mormar, degi, sapat yomalagar. Agine, dule-galebukwad ogobsamarbalid, masgi oguchamarbalid, degi, e-nailikgusadi ega nudaksamarbalid. Degi, dule-geg-nanamaladi moli-uayasuidgi-sii, Sapi-Ogobgi-Dakleged-Neggweburse Jericóʼye-nugadse sesmalad. Degi, e-gwenadgan-walik obesad. Geb degi, e-berbemalad gannar Samaria-neggweburse nonimalad.
A-ibagangi, Rey-Acaz, Asiria-reymarse bendakleged egichisad.
Ar ade, Edom-dulemar gannar Judá-dulemargi gwichigunoni gusmalad, degi, dule-gwenna-gwenna gasa-sesmalad.
Filistea-dulemardina, Judá-yargi neggwebur-nebagi-bukwadgi, degi, Neguevʼgi neggweburmar-bukwadgi sabsuli ubosmalad.
Ar Bab-Dummad Rey-Acaz-nuki, Judá-dulemar ibgwensur imaksad. Ar Acazʼde, Judá-yalagi dulemar wilub-obicha-isguega imaksad, degi, Bab-Jehováʼgi bela-bela isgusbalid.
Asiria-e-rey Tiglat-Pileserʼye-nugad, Acaz-bendaknadenad. Degi-inigwele, aka egi bila-onogega ebilis ambikusmalad.

Ar Acaz, Rey-Asiriaʼga Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi ibmar-nuegan-bukwad ukded. Degine, reyneggi ibmar-gargerbamalad-bukwad, degi, dummagan-neggi ibmar-bukwad uksabalid. Degi-inigwele, Tiglat-Pileser, Acaz-gwen-bendaksasulid, aka egi gwisgusad.
Rey-Acazʼga neg-boni-dummad-nai-inigwele, aka bur bar-buloded, Bab-Jehováʼba amba nanassulid.

Acaz, Damasco-sordamar-e-bab-dummagan-e-ogalakusadga ibmar-ogumakaled uksad. Ar ade, Acaz binsasad: “Ar Siria-bab-dummagan e-reymar-bendakdasoggua, an ega ibmar-ogumakaled ukmogale, nabir an-bendakmogoye.” Degi-inigwele, we-bab-dummagana Acaz-oberguega imaksad, degi, Israel-dulemar bela oberguega imaksabalid.

A-ukinbali, Acaz, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi bela ibmar-ebulemalad-danar-urbisgu, geb goa-goa imaksad. Deginbali, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-yawagak ediar sisad. Degi, bab-dummagan ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailamar, bela Jerusalén-neg-sukungangi sobsabalid.

Degine, Acaz, Judá-yargi neggweburmar-bukwadgi bab-dummad-baidse-goled-aila-matusurmalad sobsabalid, adi, agi bab-dummad-baiganga ibmar-wawadikid ogumakegar. Deyobi, Acaz e-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová bela-bela ourwega imaksad.
Rey-Acaz-ibmar-imakded, degi, bela e-igar-nanasadi, gebe-onoded-akale, berguedse e-ibmar-imaksadi, Judá-reymar-e-gardagi, degi, Israel-e-reymar-gardagi bela narmakar mamaid.
Acaz burgwenonigua, Jerusalén-neggweburgi digsamalad, Israel-reymar-digar-mamaidgi digsasurmalad. Geb a-sorba, e-machi-Ezequías yar-seega megnonikid.
